description: Inside the base; open days only; from the Chinese Wikipedia F-104 survivor table

Displayed on the Pingtung south apron; the Chinese Wikipedia C-119 list gives the construction serial as 51-8070 but explicitly flags it as uncertain (序號不確定是否正確) so 51-8070 is recorded as an alias not as fact

Gunship displayed on the Pingtung south apron; construction serial unknown; this is the airframe at the centre of a 1996 scandal in which after a battery short-circuit fire on 1996-06-01 the unit repainted 3181 as the recently retired 3183 to evade responsibility; the deception was exposed by a legislator and the wing commander was suspended; the true identity is 3181 and 3183 is a FALSE number the airframe has worn
